title: Two priority accounts at risk, not enough for both
story: Two priority accounts at 2 and 8 days, both would stock out, and only 100 cases. They share toward equal cover: (L-2)+(L-8) = 10 days x 10 cs/day, so L = 10 days: 80 and 20 cases. The regular market gets nothing. All three go to a human.
